name: artem-from-ua
description: Claude Code plugins by Artem Naluzhnyy: PlantUML diagram sync, custom statusline, and more

plugins.name: plantuml
plugins.description: PlantUML diagram automation: auto-sync URLs in markdown, pre-commit validation, CI checks

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Custom Claude Code statusline with API rate limits, context window, git info

plugins.name: statusline-compact
plugins.description: Minimal single-line statusline: repo/worktree/branch, model/effort/context/cost. jq + git only, no network

plugins.name: git-branch-naming
plugins.description: Git branch naming convention enforcement: validates names, warns on content mismatch

plugins.name: kb-grooming
plugins.description: Documentation health analysis: structural checks, semantic compliance, and GitHub issue creation

plugins.name: retroscope
plugins.description: Retrospective session reports: summarize tasks, decisions, and open questions from Claude Code sessions

plugins.name: playbook
plugins.description: Curated presets of coding guidelines injected into sessions on demand

plugins.name: semver
plugins.description: Semantic versioning enforcement: validates version bumps before commit/push/PR, supports multiple version files

plugins.name: ai-fortune
plugins.description: Career direction analysis: interview + AI usage pattern mining to identify roles AI won't replace

plugins.name: context
plugins.description: Inspect full Claude Code session context: CLAUDE.md files, auto-memory, and SessionStart hook output

plugins.name: technology-explainer
plugins.description: Adapts explanation depth based on user proficiency per technology: expert, intermediate, or learning

plugins.name: fresh-guides
plugins.description: Watchlist for fast-changing technologies: verifies advice against official docs before responding
